title: How to use ChatGPT to negotiate your salary

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: ChatGPT can craft precise, data-driven salary negotiation scripts tailored to your industry and experience. (3 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: But negotiating is about human nuance, not templates. ChatGPT can’t read the room or adapt to real-time feedback. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: It can analyze market data from PayScale and Glassdoor, giving you leverage with concrete numbers. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: You’re relying on AI to interpret human emotions and power dynamics — that’s not how real negotiations work. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Use ChatGPT to research, not to negotiate. The human touch is irreplaceable. (4 sec)
